statement: While a gubernatorial State of Emergency was not declared, the Vermont State Emergency Management Plan (SEMP) was implemented for this storm event.
source_title: Governor Scott's request for a major disaster declaration for the December 22 to 24, 2022 storm, February 21, 2023

statement: Based on an on-the-ground assessment, I did not declare a State of Emergency but activated the State Emergency Operations Plan (SEOP) to facilitate the provision of state resources to support local response and recovery operations through the state multi-agency coordination system.
source_title: Governor Shumlin's request for a major disaster declaration for the April 15 to 18, 2014 storms, May 21, 2014 (Joint Fiscal Office grant packet JFO 2705)

statement: While a gubernatorial State of Emergency was not declared, the Town of Pittsfield in Rutland County, pursuant to their Local Emergency Management Plan, submitted a Local Jurisdiction Request for Emergency Declaration ...
source_title: Governor Scott's request for a major disaster declaration for the April 15, 2019 storm, May 29, 2019 (Joint Fiscal Office grant packet JFO 2973)

statement: While a gubernatorial State of Emergency was not declared, the towns of Fairfax and Montgomery in Franklin County and Johnson and Hyde Park in Lamoille County each declared a local State of Emergency.
source_title: Governor Scott's request for a major disaster declaration for the October 31 to November 1, 2019 storm, December 20, 2019 (Joint Fiscal Office grant packet JFO 3009)

statement: While a gubernatorial State of Emergency was not declared, the Towns of Putney and Townshend activated Local Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs).
source_title: Governor Scott's request for a major disaster declaration for the July 29 to 30, 2021 storm, September 13, 2021 (Joint Fiscal Office grant packet JFO 3095)
